scope.description: Model publication APIs, JSON/bin path resolution and adjacent identity/snapshot/watcher contracts; not a whole-project certification

findings.title: Concurrent read-clone-store loses distinct-asset publications
findings.mechanism: Two writers copy the same map; unconditional publication of the second copy discards the first insertion despite each caller returning successfully.
findings.fix: One store_global path using ArcSwap::rcu; parsing/validation and model Arc allocation outside the retry closure.
limits: No protection against direct external map stores

findings.title: Textual path replacement changes parents/stems and can overwrite the JSON source
findings.mechanism: replace modifies all extension substrings; for an extensionless path, the implicit cache target equals the source.
findings.fix: Path::with_extension for recognized json/bin pairs; other names remain validated JSON sources without an implicit cache.

findings.title: Publication order does not enforce model-generation order
findings.mechanism: A delayed older writer may replace the same key after a newer publication; data/API carry no generation or expected predecessor.
findings.closure: Versioned compare-and-publish with explicit authorized rollback and inverted-arrival tests. Hash ordering is not version ordering.

findings.title: Individual snapshots do not define coherent multi-head generations
findings.mechanism: MOTOR/VOL/OI are fetched independently and published separately; even one map snapshot could capture a partial ensemble update.
findings.not_a_finding: Directional prediction and its base share the same active_forest snapshot.
findings.closure: Explicit asynchronous compatibility or validated bundle publication plus per-decision version receipt.

findings.title: Public mutable global permits bypass of cooperative publication contract
findings.mechanism: GLOBAL_FORESTS remains public; two existing test helpers use direct load-clone-store. No other direct production writer found in searched crates/src scope.
findings.closure: Audit external consumers, encapsulate mutation compatibly, define fixture APIs and test concurrency isolation.

findings.title: Watcher alternates one per-stem timestamp across JSON and BIN
findings.mechanism: With different stable mtimes, JSON writes t_json and BIN writes t_bin into the same stem slot each pass, causing repeated reloads without content changes.
findings.closure: Canonical per-key artifact, observed-versus-activated state, success-based timestamp advancement and unchanged-second-pass tests.

findings.title: mtime and structural validity do not bind cached predictor to manifest JSON
findings.mechanism: Path repair preserves newer/equal-mtime BIN preference and standalone compatibility; no source/payload provenance binding is added.
findings.closure: Versioned source/payload lineage, migration policy and served-predictor receipt, independent of statistical promotion evidence.
